in_marathi.name: Divesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dive, Deep + God, Lord
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Divesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Dive' meaning 'to dive' or 'to plunge' and 'Ish' meaning 'God' or 'Lord'. This name symbolizes a deep connection with the divine and a strong spiritual foundation.
